items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Rudy Powell was in the band with me and June Clark down on 14th Street.

ctx.x: Frankie and I would work -- we worked some dancing school things together. Frankie was out that age too.
Rudy Powell was in the band with me and June Clark down on 14th Street. That was the alto player -- Rudy Powell.
